xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4384: Approved, green PRs that turn CONFLICTING sit forever: route them back for a sync-main repair

plan.title: Approved, green PRs that turn CONFLICTING sit forever: route them back for a sync-main repair
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Six vertical items across cloister, the review route, the dashboard service host and two docs; well under the 25-file and 6-subsystem limits.

narratives.Problem: An approved PR with green checks that becomes CONFLICTING with main sits forever. The merge gate refuses it before any merge door can rebase it, the pre-review conflict gate only runs before review dispatch, and the merge-train reconciler only runs after a merge with merge_train enabled and never sees CONFLICTING PRs. Even after a manual sync, GitHub does not dismiss approvals on this repo, so requestReviewGuarded short-circuits the re-request as already-passed while the merge gate needs approval at the new head. PR #4317 (PAN-1166) and #4322 (PAN-4311) sat CONFLICTING/DIRTY/APPROVED for about 13 hours on 2026-09-28/29.
narratives.Proposal: Add a dashboard-process conflict-repair patrol (60 s tick) that derives 'merge-ready except for mergeable:false' from live PR facts with the merge gate's own policy, delivers one sync-main repair instruction per PR head to the work agent through resolveIssueFeedbackTarget + messageAgent, journals conflict.repair-requested, escalates once to Needs-you (surfaceIssueFeedbackNeedsYou + conflict.repair-escalated) when the conflict survives the repair for 45 minutes or the agent is unreachable, and backstops the re-review of the repaired head. Make requestReviewGuarded head-bound so a stale approval no longer blocks re-review. The existing auto-merge scheduler re-arms the repaired, re-approved head. Document the step in docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md and docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No server-side automatic rebase, merge, or conflict resolution of a conflicting branch
- No change to merge_train flags, merge-train-reconciler.ts, or merge-train-deps.ts
- No change to the pre-review conflict gate (conflict-gate.ts) behavior or its prompt
- No stored status column, table, or flag; the journal entries record actions only
- No new HTTP route
- No agent pause and no 'needs-you:' pause reason for this escalation
- No change to reReviewGuardError on the /api/review/:id/trigger path
- No edits to src/lib/cloister/pr-facts.ts (at 993 of the 1000-line ceiling)
- No change to auto-merge-executor.ts, auto-merge-scheduler.ts, or merge-sync.ts
- No GitHub branch-protection change

autoDecisions.summary: Host the patrol in the dashboard process (a service beside auto-merge-executor.ts started from main.ts), not in deacon-lite.
autoDecisions.rationale: Deacon-lite runs in the deacon child, which has no resume-with-prompt precedent (grep for resumeAgent/spawnRun/messageAgent in its routines finds none) and POST /api/agents takes no prompt; every prompt-carrying dispatch (review-verdict-feedback, conflict-gate) runs in the dashboard process, and requestReviewGuarded is callable in-process there.

autoDecisions.summary: Dispatch through resolveIssueFeedbackTarget then messageAgent(owesRework, feedbackRedelivery, dedupKey conflict-repair:<issue>:<head8>).
autoDecisions.rationale: It is the established feedback door: wakes a live agent, resumes or starts a stopped one, respects operator pauses, and returns needsYou when nothing is reachable, matching the issue's 'wake, or spawn one if none is alive'.

autoDecisions.summary: One repair per PR head; the episode key is the head sha (8 chars) journaled as data.head.
autoDecisions.rationale: A repair moves the head, so a later conflict on a new approved head is a genuinely new episode; journal-derived counting survives dashboard restarts.

autoDecisions.summary: Escalate after a 45-minute grace if the same head is still merge-ready but conflicting.
autoDecisions.rationale: A sync-main, resolution, gates and push take tens of minutes; deacon-lite's review recovery uses a 60-minute cooldown; 45 minutes bounds operator wait far below the 13 hours observed.

autoDecisions.summary: Read AC3 ('a second failed repair raises Needs-you') as: the second time the patrol would repair the same episode, it escalates instead.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's Wanted section says escalate if the conflict survives one repair attempt; this reading satisfies both and never loops.

autoDecisions.summary: Needs-you = surfaceIssueFeedbackNeedsYou plus a conflict.repair-escalated journal entry; no agent pause.
autoDecisions.rationale: It is the Needs-you door every feedback relay uses; a 'needs-you:' pause is lifted by the resurrection ladder and would stop an agent that may still be repairing.

autoDecisions.summary: Make requestReviewGuarded head-bound via readApprovalStandsAtHead in merge-gate.ts; false starts a review, true/unknown keep today's behavior.
autoDecisions.rationale: GitHub branch protection is absent on eltmon/overdeck (API 404), so approvals are not dismissed on push and the guard would return already-passed for the repaired head; without this AC2 cannot hold.

autoDecisions.summary: The patrol also re-requests review once (15-minute backstop) when a repaired head is mergeable and no review.requested followed the repair.
autoDecisions.rationale: AC2 must not depend on the work agent remembering to run pan review request.

autoDecisions.summary: AC2 relies on the existing auto-merge scheduler, which re-arms a blocked/failed row for a new head once the merge gate passes.
autoDecisions.rationale: latestAutoMergeAllowsSchedule already re-arms new heads; adding another merge door would duplicate the merge path. 'Without operator action' means beyond what the issue's auto-merge policy already requires.

autoDecisions.summary: The repair prompt names concrete per-file rules for generated files (file-size allowlist, codebase-map md, bun.lock, slash-command manifest, .pan state).
autoDecisions.rationale: The two stuck PRs conflict on scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt and .overdeck/context/codebase/concerns.md; the pre-push guard refuses agent allowlist raises, so the agent must be told not to raise caps.

items.title: Add evaluateConflictRepairGate and readApprovalStandsAtHead to merge-gate.ts

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-1 exactly. In src/lib/cloister/merge-gate.ts add evaluateConflictRepairGate(issueId, deps) returning { conflicting, reason?, facts }: conflicting only when facts are open, mergeable === false, not draft, no change request, checks green, approval proven at head (facts.approvedAtHead or forgeApprovalAtHead read directly, never withForgeApprovalAtHead), and evaluateMergeReadiness({...facts, mergeable: true}) with the same ciTestsRequired/uatRequired/requireApprovalAtHead policy as evaluateIssueMergeGate is ready. Add readApprovalStandsAtHead(issueId, deps) returning true/false/undefined as specified. Import forgeApprovalAtHead from ./pr-facts.js; do not edit pr-facts.ts. Write the new test file with injected getFacts/readReviews/overdeckLogins/ciTestsRequired/uatRequired.

items.title: Given an open GitHub PR approved at its head, checks green and mergeable false, evaluateConflictRepairGate returns conflicting: true
evaluateConflictRepairGate returns conflicting: false when mergeable is true or null, checks are red or pending, changes are requested, or the only approving review names an older commit
readApprovalStandsAtHead returns true for a marker at head, false for an approving review of an older commit, and undefined when the facts carry an error
git diff shows src/lib/cloister/pr-facts.ts unchanged and merge-gate-conflict-repair.test.ts passes under npx vitest run
Make requestReviewGuarded re-review an approved PR whose approval is stale at the head

expected_outputs: review-pipeline.ts line count is at most 1000

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-2. In requestReviewGuarded (review-pipeline.ts) change the approved short-circuit to `derived.pr?.reviewState === 'approved' && await (options.approvalStandsAtHead ?? readApprovalStandsAtHead)(canonicalIssueId) !== false`, add the optional approvalStandsAtHead test seam to its options type, update its doc comment to say a stale approval is re-reviewed, and import readApprovalStandsAtHead from lib/cloister/merge-gate.js. Add 'conflict-repair' to the RequestReviewSource union in src/lib/cloister/request-review-pipeline.ts. Keep review-pipeline.ts at or under 1000 lines. Write the new test following review-pipeline-route.test.ts mocking patterns.

items.title: Given reviewState approved and approvalStandsAtHead resolving false, requestReviewGuarded starts the review pipeline instead of returning already-passed
Given reviewState approved, checks green and approvalStandsAtHead resolving true or undefined, requestReviewGuarded returns already-passed
Given reviewState approved, checks pending and approvalStandsAtHead resolving true, requestReviewGuarded returns tests-requeued
wc -l shows review-pipeline.ts at or under 1000 lines and RequestReviewSource accepts 'conflict-repair' under npm run typecheck
Conflict-repair tick: detect, send one repair per head, escalate once

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-3. Add 'conflict.repair-requested' and 'conflict.repair-escalated' to PipelineJournalEntryType. Create src/lib/cloister/conflict-repair.ts exporting CONFLICT_REPAIR_INTERVAL_MS (60_000), CONFLICT_REPAIR_GRACE_MS (45 min), CONFLICT_REPAIR_REVIEW_BACKSTOP_MS (15 min), ConflictRepairDeps (all I/O injectable with the defaults listed in the PRD), isConflictRepairCandidate, buildConflictRepairPrompt (the exact prompt text in the PRD, including push and pan review request), tickConflictRepair (journal pre-filter, pause check, evaluateConflictRepairGate, then repair / wait / escalate per head8 exactly as the PRD decision list says, per-issue try/catch), and __resetConflictRepairStateForTests. Escalation calls surfaceIssueFeedbackNeedsYou then appends conflict.repair-escalated. Tests use vi.useFakeTimers + vi.setSystemTime, a real temp-dir journal, and injected deps; no source-grep, no skipIf.

items.title: Given an approved-verdict journal and a gate answering conflicting, the first tickConflictRepair sends one repair message and records one conflict.repair-requested entry whose data.head is the head's first 8 chars
A second tick 10 minutes later, and a tick after __resetConflictRepairStateForTests, sends no second repair for the same head
When the same head is still conflicting 45 minutes after the repair entry, the tick calls surfaceNeedsYou once and records one conflict.repair-escalated entry; a later tick records nothing new
When resolveTarget returns needsYou, the tick records conflict.repair-escalated with reason 'unreachable' and no conflict.repair-requested entry

The tick skips a paused issue, a journal whose last verdict is CHANGES_REQUESTED or is followed by merge.completed, and a gate answering not conflicting; buildConflictRepairPrompt output contains 'pan sync-main', 'push', and 'pan review request'
Backstop: re-request review once for a repaired, mergeable head

expected_outputs: conflict-repair.test.ts passes including the backstop cases

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-4 in conflict-repair.ts. When the gate says not conflicting, take the latest conflict.repair-requested entry R and call deps.requestReview(issueId) (default: getGuardedReviewRequester() from ./request-review-pipeline.js with source 'conflict-repair'; log and skip when none is registered) only when the PR is open and mergeable true, the current head8 differs from R.data.head, no review.requested entry follows R, R is at least CONFLICT_REPAIR_REVIEW_BACKSTOP_MS old, no conflict entry exists for the current head, and the issue is unpaused. Guard repeats with an in-memory per-issue lastBackstopAt window. Reuse the gate's facts; no extra forge read. Add fake-timer test cases.

items.title: Given a repair entry for head A, a PR now at head B and mergeable, and no review.requested after the repair, a tick 15 minutes after the repair calls requestReview exactly once
The tick does not call requestReview when a review.requested entry follows the repair, when the head is still A, or when the repair entry is younger than 15 minutes
When requestReview refuses, the next tick inside the 15-minute window sends no second request
Run the conflict-repair patrol on a 60 s tick in the dashboard process

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-5. Create src/dashboard/server/services/conflict-repair-patrol.ts mirroring auto-merge-executor.ts runTick/start/stop: startConflictRepairPatrol returns false for OVERDECK_DISABLE_CONFLICT_REPAIR=1, a peer dashboard (isPeerDashboardProcess), or an already running timer; the interval is CONFLICT_REPAIR_INTERVAL_MS with unref; runTick skips an overlapping tick and returns before tickConflictRepair while isDeaconGloballyPaused() is true. Accept an injectable tick function for tests. In main.ts start it beside startAutoMergeExecutor with started/SKIPPED log lines and call stopConflictRepairPatrol next to stopAutoMergeExecutor on shutdown.

items.title: Given startConflictRepairPatrol has run, advancing fake timers by 60 000 ms runs the injected tick exactly once
startConflictRepairPatrol returns false when OVERDECK_DISABLE_CONFLICT_REPAIR is '1', and no tick runs while isDeaconGloballyPaused returns true
When a tick is still in flight, the next interval returns without starting a second tick
main.ts calls startConflictRepairPatrol beside startAutoMergeExecutor and stopConflictRepairPatrol beside stopAutoMergeExecutor, and npm run typecheck exits 0
Document conflict repair in PIPELINE-GATES.md and MERGE-WORKFLOW.md
